**<sub><sub>![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Treat a nonempty ID as new after an ID-less call**

When a compatible provider first emits an ID-less call and then starts a distinct call with a nonempty ID at the same reused index, this guard stays false because `tool_call["id"]` is falsy. The following merge path drops the new ID/name/type and concatenates its arguments into the prior call; before this change, any nonempty differing ID opened a new entry, so these streams now produce a silently corrupted span. Compare incoming IDs even when the stored one is `None` (or explicitly handle late ID hydration) rather than unconditionally merging.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

<!-- codex-code-review-finding:v1 -->

**<sub><sub>![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Add cassette-backed coverage for the provider response shape**

The new regression tests only pass handcrafted chunks through the postprocessor, so they never establish that Gemini/Together/vLLM produce this multi-call wire shape or that the full `wrap_openai` streaming path logs it correctly; a mistaken synthetic payload or parser/version difference can therefore leave all three tests green while the production bug remains. Keep these as supplemental unit cases, but add a VCR-backed test against at least one claimed compatible provider, as required for response-shape-dependent integration behavior.

AGENTS.md reference: [AGENTS.md:L184-L186](https://github.com/braintrustdata/braintrust-sdk-python/blob/5b9e5da08b27644f999027ef12d0066b2069a275/AGENTS.md#L184-L186)

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

<!-- codex-code-review-finding:v1 -->

Good catch: a call that arrived without an id stored `id=None`, so the guard never fired and a later call with an id under the same index was merged into it. Fixed in f8972ee: any non-empty id that differs from the stored one now opens a new call, as before this change; id-less continuation fragments still extend the current call (the GLM-4.6 test still passes). Added `test_chat_completion_streaming_call_with_id_after_call_without_id_under_reused_index`, which fails on the previous commit.

There's no cassette because the official OpenAI API never streams several calls in one delta, and recording one needs keys for a provider that does (Gemini's OpenAI-compatible endpoint, Together, vLLM), which aren't available here. The shape was reproduced end to end through `wrap_openai` against a local OpenAI-compatible SSE endpoint (before: only the first call in the span; after: both). If a maintainer can record a cassette against one of those providers, happy to wire it in; or this can include that end-to-end test with a local fake server instead, if you prefer.
